messages:
tia (design): hey team — new compact view for the regression diff list + bulk-approve flow. posting quick gif: https://imgur.com/mock-gif (ignore the blur, focus on layout)
sam (pm): :eyes: nice. what's the goal here vs current scorecard list? smaller density? faster scanning?
kai (frontend): goal is 3-up density for power users. main changes: inline diff snippets, single-row score badges, and a right-aligned bulk action rail that appears on multi-select.
tia (design): yes — we want to surface pass/fail, confidence, and a short example snippet. want approve CTA exposed but not overly aggressive.
sam (pm): two product concerns: 1) bulk approve should show a confirmation for >10 items, 2) UX copy — "Approve" vs "Mark as accepted" — clarity for audits.
anya (a11y): quick accessibility nits after scanning the gif: focus outline is gone when selecting rows with keyboard; screenreader doesn't announce how many items are selected when the bulk-action rail appears.
kai (frontend): good catches — the outline is removed by the compact focus CSS. i can tweak. for SR announce i was thinking aria-live on the rail: we could do `aria-live="polite"` and update with "3 items selected".
tia (design): draft copy proposals: Bulk CTA label: "Approve selected (n)" — visible count in parenthesis. Confirmation modal title: "Confirm bulk approval". Danger copy: "This will mark X tests as approved and close their open regressions." any objections?
sam (pm): prefer "Mark as approved" to keep verb tense consistent with single-item flows. also add undo: toast with "Undo" for 10s.
anya (a11y): can we avoid using parentheses for the count? VoiceOver reads parentheses awkwardly. better to have label: "Approve selected — 3" or keep the count as a separate `span` with `aria-hidden="true"` and a visually hidden text that reads "3 selected".
kai (frontend): implementation note: current toolbar is a separate DOM node inserted when selection > 0. aria-live on insertion should read it automatically but VoiceOver sometimes ignores newly inserted nodes unless focus is moved or there's a live region update.
tia (design): suggestion: when selection changes, update a visually hidden live region with plain text like "3 tests selected". don't move focus, just announce.
anya (a11y): yes — use a dedicated `<div id="selection-announcer" aria-live="polite" class="sr-only">` and update its innerText on selection changes. avoid repeated announcements on each focus change.
kai (frontend): noted. small CSS nit: the inline snippet truncation uses `-webkit-line-clamp: 2` — it crops mid-word on ios, maybe use a fade mask instead.
tia (design): agree — fade mask better for readability. also UX question: should an inline expand toggle be available per-row? feels heavy in compact mode.
sam (pm): only if user explicitly requests more detail. default compact keeps rows single-line for throughput.
tia (design): final microcopy tweak: confirmation modal primary button text: "Confirm approve" vs "Approve tests"? which reads clearer to you?
anya (a11y): "Approve tests" is shorter and easier for screen reader navigation. confirm affordance is implied by modal context.
kai (frontend): i'll prototype with: toolbar label "3 selected", primary "Approve tests", secondary "Cancel", toast with "3 tests approved — Undo".
bot-evals: deploy-preview available at https://staging.redwood.ai/evals/compact-rail (build 7890) :package:
tia (design): thanks! can folks review the staging link and drop 1-line verification (keyboard, SR announce, copy) before EOD? leaving a pinned checklist below:
- keyboard focus outline restored and visible
- selection announcer reads counts correctly
- CTA copy uses "Approve tests"
- fade mask for snippets
- undo toast appears after bulk approve
sam (pm): i'll check keyboard and toast. :thumbsup:
kai (frontend): will push a branch with notes, aiming for end-of-day merge if no blockers.
anya (a11y): i'll test with NVDA and VoiceOver, report any wording changes.
tia (design): awesome — thanks all. :sparkles:
